actions.text: Pressing Refresh re-fetches the updater log file list.
Pressing Clear runs the DeleteUpdateLogFiles command, then re-fetches the list when the command finishes.
Choosing an item in the logs menu navigates to the Log Files or Updater Log Files page.

rules.text: Running the same command again within 5 seconds of the previous one is ignored, and a console warning is logged.
The "log level default" note is shown only when the current view is "Log Files". It does not appear on this updater page.
The file list is loaded from the /log/file/update path. It defaults to an empty list until data arrives.

shows.text: The page is titled "Log Files" and has a heading "Log Files" with the scope "System".

A logs menu button in the toolbar shows the current view, which is "Updater Log Files" on this page. Its menu links to "Log Files" (/system/logs/files) and "Updater Log Files" (/system/logs/files/update).
The toolbar has "Refresh" and "Clear" buttons. The Refresh icon spins while log files are being fetched. The Clear icon spins while the delete-update-log-files command is queued or started.
An alert shows the log files location. It is the app data folder plus "UpdateLogs", joined with a backslash on Windows and a forward slash otherwise.
A loading indicator shows while log files are being fetched.
When not fetching and there are files, a table lists them. Each row shows the filename, the last write time as a relative date, and a "Download" link that opens in a new tab.
When not fetching and there are no files, an info alert shows the "No log files" message (translation key NoLogFiles).

sideEffects.text: Pressing Clear posts a command named DeleteUpdateLogFiles to /command. The command is stored in the local command cache on success.
Loading the list sends a GET request with the API key and client headers.

unknowns.reason: HTTP GET to a URL built at runtime

findings.explanation: The location Alert is rendered without a kind (only the NoLogFiles alert has kind={kinds.INFO}), so the source doesn't show it as an info alert.
findings.reason: Removed the word "info" from the location alert statement, since that alert has no kind set.
